privacy.metaTitle: Privacy policy — Embedded Artificial Intelligence club
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use and protect your personal data, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: This site is run by the “Embedded Artificial Intelligence” (IAE) club. The club board is responsible for processing the personal data described on this page.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: When you request membership: name, phone, email, cohort, track and an optional message. When you complete the membership form through your personal link: the additional information requested, your photo, your Apogee / Massar number and photos of both sides of your student card. Through the contact form: name, email and message. The site uses no advertising trackers; the font is loaded from Google Fonts.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To review and answer membership requests, manage membership and the annual fee, organize club activities and reply to your messages. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: Only authorized club officers, according to their role. Attached documents (photo, student card) are stored in a private, unpublished space and every access is logged. The public site shows only members' name, photo, cohort, track, university and profession.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep data as long as it is needed to review your request or manage your membership. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, object to the processing of, and request deletion of your data, under Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data; you may also contact the CNDP. To exercise your rights, contact us through the contact form on the home page.

sections.title: Updates to this policy
sections.body: We may change this page when our practices change; the last-updated date is shown at the top.

fields.contentHint: Visible to players (question text, board…). Never put the answer or solution here.
fields.solutionHint: A JSON value compared with the player's answer (a quoted string, number, array or object).
fields.solutionMissing: No solution is saved for this challenge yet; it can't be published until you add one.
fields.solutionKeep: Leave empty to keep the current solution
fields.solutionPrivate: The solution is stored in a table closed to players, is never sent to them, and is not written to the audit log.
fields.codeHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter (e.g. first_win).
fields.bonusHint: Granted once when the achievement is unlocked (0 = no bonus).
fields.criteriaGameHint: Leave on “All games” to count challenges across every game.

games.needCategory: Add a category first before creating a game.
games.deleteConfirm: If the game has player history (attempts or points) it will be archived instead of deleted to preserve historical data; otherwise it is permanently deleted with its challenges.

challenges.needGame: Add a game first before creating a challenge.
challenges.reorderHint: Pick a game from the list to reorder its challenges.
challenges.deleteConfirm: If the challenge has player history (attempts or points) it will be archived instead of deleted to preserve historical data; otherwise it is permanently deleted with its solution.

levels.hint: The point thresholds a player's level is computed from. A level at 0 points must always exist.
levels.zeroLocked: The 0-point level can't be deleted or have its threshold changed.
levels.deleteConfirm: Players' levels will be recomputed from the remaining thresholds.

players.hint: Accounts that have played or have points are listed; search also covers admin and member accounts so you can adjust their points.
players.adjustHint: Grant or deduct points with a mandatory reason. It's recorded in the points ledger and the audit log and can't be edited afterwards.

errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.games_access_denied: You don't have permission for this operation.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts, try again later.
errors.verification_unavailable: Verification isn't available for this challenge.
errors.invalid_delta: Enter a non-zero integer within the allowed limit.
errors.note_required: A reason for the adjustment is required (up to 500 characters).
errors.slug_taken: This identifier (slug) is already in use.
errors.solution_required: A challenge can't be published without a saved solution.
errors.level_zero_required: The 0-point level can't be deleted or have its threshold changed.
errors.unsupported_verify_mode: This verification type isn't supported yet.
errors.history_locked: A challenge with player history can't be moved to another game.
errors.invalid_json: Invalid JSON (content must be an object, and the solution can't be null).
errors.content_has_answer: The public content contains an answer or solution key (e.g. solution/answer). Move it to the solution field.
errors.duplicate_value: Duplicate value (identifier, code or points threshold already in use).
errors.invalid_reference: Invalid reference, or the item is linked to other data.
errors.nameRequired: Enter text in at least one language.
errors.slugInvalid: Invalid identifier: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens only.
errors.kindInvalid: Invalid type: starts with a lowercase Latin letter (2–32 characters from a-z, 0-9 and _).
errors.datesInvalid: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.codeInvalid: Invalid code: starts with a lowercase Latin letter (2–64 characters from a-z, 0-9 and _).
